title: Why Did My Organic Traffic Drop? Find the Cause in 4 Checks
description:
Traffic dropped and you don't know why? Don't start rewriting pages yet. Check these four things in Google Search Console first, in this order. Each one rules a cause in or out, and the pattern you find tells you whether your rankings fell or only your clicks did.

Full written guide, with every report and filter: https://useflowra.com/blog/why-did-my-traffic-drop?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=t001

Chapters
0:00 Your traffic dropped. Don't panic yet
0:30 Check 1: is the drop real, or a tracking problem?
1:27 Check 2: seasonality or a real drop?
2:04 Check 3: find where the drop lives
2:59 Check 4: did rankings drop, or only clicks?
3:32 Path A: rankings dropped (updates, manual actions, technical faults)
4:13 Path B: rankings held but clicks fell (AI Overviews and results page changes)
4:35 Doing this every month without the spreadsheet

Every number in the video is example data.

Flowra connects Search Console, GA4 and WordPress, finds the pages losing traffic and helps you fix them. Free to start: https://useflowra.com?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=t001

pinnedComment: Which check found your cause? If it was Path B (rankings steady, clicks down), say which query, and we'll look at it in a future video. Written guide: https://useflowra.com/blog/why-did-my-traffic-drop
